messages:
maria: Starting a staged driver + CUDA roll for Dedicated A100 fleet tonight. Canary group = 10 nodes in us-east1-d (reserved). Goal: validate driver 535.x + CUDA 12.2 for nccl/p2p and network stability. Start 02:00 UTC, rolling window 30m.

ajay: SGTM. Add smoke checks: nccl allreduce, p2p bandwidth, MTU mismatch, and kernel oops grep. Also notify oncall.

ops-bot: canary deploy initiated on canary-3 (group canary-3, nodes: a100-resv-04..13). deploy-id=dep-20260315-01. Expected rollout 10m.

sasha: seeing NIC link flaps on canary-3 ~2m after driver install. Quick tail of dmesg shows repeated mlx5 errors and NV peer complaints. :eyes:

jin: paste of the top lines:```
[ 123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, general protection fault
[ 124.001234] mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: mlx5e_probe() failed -ENOMEM
[ 124.002000] nv_peer_mem: invalid peer descriptor
```

ajay: that mlx5 line smells like firmware/driver mismatch or unexpected memory pressure from the kernel module. Can we confirm kernel version and mlx5 fw on that rack?

sasha: kernel 5.15.43 on those nodes, mlx5 fw 22.38. Upgrade matrix showed support but not exhaustively tested for 535.2.1.

maria: pause the staged rollout for other pools. Rollback canary-3 to driver 530.41 and re-run smoke. Use the rollback script below. Notify customers flagged for dedicated SLA.

jin: rollback command I used:```
./infra/driver-manager rollback --group canary-3 --driver 530.41 --restart-services --timeout 900
```

ops-bot: rollback started (dep-rollback-20260315-01). Tracking logs at /var/log/deploys/dep-rollback-20260315-01.log

ops-bot: rollback completed for canary-3 in 7m. 10/10 pods back to Running, kube-probe: OK. Health check summary: latency delta <= 2% vs baseline.

sasha: perf numbers returned to baseline but two nodes show lower KV cache hit rates for prefix caching — likely a transient after reboot. Monitoring alerts cleared after ~8m.

ajay: propose a phased strategy: 1) hold EU/APAC pools (eu-west2, asia-east1) 2) continue NAM only but restrict to isolated NVLink-less racks 3) expand smoke to include MTU, mlx5 counters, and NV peer mem metrics 4) add automated rollback trigger on >5% error spikes in 10m window.

maria: agreed. Also, ops: increase diagnostics retention to 1h of high-res perf (1s samples) for the canaries. We need traces if this recurs.

oncall: I'll take ownership for the window and schedule oncall rotation. I'll also post a short customer-facing msg to dedicated-customers channel about a temporary upgrade hold.

ajay: created a small automated test harness snippet to run after driver install:```
# smoke.sh
./nccl_bench --allreduce --size 64MB --iters 20 || exit 1
ping -M do -s 8972 $PEER || exit 2
cat /var/log/kern.log | grep -iE "mlx5|nv_peer_mem|NVRM" && exit 3
```

maria: good. action items inline: [maria] coordinate customer comms, [ajay] add harness to deploy pipeline, [jin] inventory fw/kernel on EU racks, [sasha] run extended canary in NAM isolated pool, [oncall] monitor.

ops-bot: incident INC-20260315-A100-DRIVER created and linked to thread. Priority=P2.

maria: We'll reconvene in the #eng-infra handoff channel at 03:15 UTC with canary metrics snapshot. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
